Navigation v2 normative examples — 2026-11-04
Static non-executable protocol data, NOT an automated test suite.
Authority: mobile/docs/protocol.md, phase 2 implemented contract.
Integers little endian, CRC32/ISO-HDLC; SHA256 over full object.
Context vehicle=1 connection=2 display=3 navigation session=7.
Source descriptor digest bytes01..20(hex); style1 attribution1.
Control and LOCATION/PROGRESS sequence streams are independent.
Projection anchors: lat=0 lon=0 -> world east=0 north=0;
z0/x0/y0 u2048/v2048 -> east=0 north=0;
z1/x1/y0 u0/v4096 -> east=0 north=0;
z1/x0/y0 u4096/v4096 -> east=0 north=0 (shared seam).
At lon180 use wrapped east=-20037508.342789244; y never wraps.
Latitude bound E7=+/-850511287. Tile-local extent=4096 inclusive.
For local snapshot integer metres, ties round away from zero.
DATA_CELL_MTU247 is124 bytes; MTU96 sends49+31 DATA bytes instead.
Expected errors are contextual descriptions; these examples are not run here.
